profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer & DPT | Bridging Clinical Workflows & Scalable Tech | TypeScript & Python
profile.summary:
As a Full Stack Software Engineer, I build clinical platforms end-to-end. I combine deep technical expertise in modern web architecture with a Doctor of Physical Therapy background to bridge the gap between healthcare operations and innovative software solutions. I don't just write code for healthcare; I provide a vital inside view of the workflows I design and optimize.  

I specialize in architecting and implementing full-stack solutions using Next.js and Django. My expertise spans from crafting intuitive user interfaces to developing the scalable API infrastructures that support complex healthcare data workflows, handling massive datasets without compromising speed or security.  

Key Technical Achievements:
Architected HIPAA-compliant authentication and authorization systems that secure highly sensitive patient medical records while enabling sophisticated healthcare licensing models across multiple care settings.

Engineered parallel API architectures bridging Django and Next.js, optimizing data flow and UI rendering while ensuring secure healthcare data transmission.

Contributed to the transformation of internal Django APIs into robust, external-facing RESTful services, implementing industry best practices to support an expanding customer base and third-party API consumption.

Technical Stack: 
- Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Material UI
- Backend: Python, Django, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL 
- Infrastructure: AWS, Neovim

positions.title: Clinical Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack engineer building clinical platforms end-to-end. My background as a physical therapist provides a vital inside view of the healthcare workflows I design and optimize, allowing me to bridge the gap between clinical requirements and technical execution. 

Key Projects & Achievements:

Performance Optimization: Engineered a progressive data loading architecture for clinical data grids handling 100k+ member records. Collaborated on backend Django pre-warming strategies to reduce total load times from ~3 minutes to under 30 seconds.  

AI Decision Support: Orchestrated the technical spec process for AI decision support modules, serving as the bridge between clinical requirements and backend data availability. Delivered concrete feature specs to ML engineers and built the complete Next.js dashboard to surface risk scores and clinical insights.  

Security & Authentication: Architected a multi-layered Next.js/Django authentication system managing dual session tokens, CSRF security, and enterprise SAML SSO integration.  

Data Pipeline Engineering: Replaced static frontend mock data with a dynamic Python/Django demo pipeline. Built management commands to extract real clinical data, scrub PHI to Safe Harbor standards, and automatically provision functional demo environments for the sales team.

positions.title: Physical Therapist
positions.description: Practiced in orthopedic outpatient care, developing a deep, hands-on understanding of clinical workflows, provider pain points, and healthcare data requirements
positions.insights: Team Leadership, Physical Therapy and +2 skills

positions.title: Physical Therapy Doctoral Resident
positions.description:
Completed rigorous, full-time clinical residencies, managing autonomous outpatient and inpatient caseloads.

- U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs: Managed full-time rehabilitation caseload for veterans, focusing on orthopedic and post-operative care.

- Duke University Health System: Delivered high-volume acute/outpatient care, gaining hands-on experience with complex EMR workflows and interdisciplinary medical communication.
